turns.user_input: Load all 3 datasets from data/crm.csv, data/billing.csv, and data/support.csv. Describe their schemas and how many records each has.
Try to join them. What's the best join key across all 3 datasets? What challenges do you see with the email fields?
The email fields don't always match — for example 'john@acme.com' in CRM vs 'john.doe@acme.com' in billing. Write a fuzzy matching function that can find likely matches across the datasets.
Run the fuzzy join across all 3 datasets. How many records matched exactly, how many partially matched (confidence between 0.5 and 0.8), and how many were unmatched?
For the partial matches (those with confidence between 0.5 and 0.8), show me the pairs so I can review them manually.

I've reviewed them. Confirm these matches as correct: john@acme.com matches john.doe@acme.com, diana@wayne.com matches d.prince@wayne.com, and maria@shield.gov matches mhill@shield.gov. Reject any others.
Generate the final unified customer view with all fields merged and save it to the workspace.
